audience: Croatian companies that send and receive e-invoices through ePoslovanje

useCases.title: Validate and send an e-invoice
useCases.text: Validate the UBL invoice XML against the EN16931 and CIUS-2025 rules. Then send it to the buyer. A sent invoice cannot be unsent.

useCases.title: Track an invoice after it was sent
useCases.text: Look up the status of an invoice by its number, both OIBs and issue year. No ePoslovanje id is needed.

useCases.title: Review e-invoices received this month
useCases.text: List the incoming e-invoices by insert, modify or issue date. Open one to read its signed XML.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a received invoice
useCases.text: Set a received invoice to approved, rejected or fully paid. Only the buyer can change these statuses.

useCases.title: Check whether a customer is on AMS
useCases.text: Check whether a company, by its OIB or GLN, is published on the Tax Authority AMS service.
